how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:hunter-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3082:obj:0: Speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3082:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:3082:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the hunter trainer Jen'shan. She would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3082:completion:0: Now we teach them those things, and they teach us others. We become one race... almost. We be allies for long time now. So you remember to help them. And Jen'shan remember to help you.
rows.quest:3082:completion:1: BJen'shan teach you da ways of the hunter--teach you good. You never forget, ⟦2⟧'s be respected greatly by da tribe. You be havin' a large role to play in da future... you never forget that.
rows.quest:3082:completion:2: BWhen you feel da need, come to Jen'shan. She teach you as much as she can when she feel you ready.
rows.quest:3087:obj:0: Read the Etched Parchment and speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3087:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:3087:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the hunter trainer Jen'shan. She would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3087:completion:0: When we finish speakin', you should talk to da rest of da citizens in da Valley. They ask you to do tings for them... tings that will test your skill and teach you some of da dangers of this land.
rows.quest:3087:completion:1: BAs you grow in experience and wisdom, you be needin' Jen'shan to show you better techniques and skills. Come back to Jen'shan often. I will let you know what I can teach you.
rows.quest:3092:obj:0: Read the Etched Note and speak to Lanka Farshot in Red Cloud Mesa.
rows.quest:3092:details:0: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, ⟦4⟧. I believe she was sent by the hunter trainer Lanka. If this note is from Lanka, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.⟦5⟧
rows.quest:3092:completion:0: And it is my job to make sure you are prepared by teaching you the basics of our profession--how to tame your pet, how to fire your rifle, and many other skills that will become necessary.
rows.quest:3092:completion:1: BHunters are a strong part of our tradition and history, ⟦6⟧. You would do well to remember how important you are to the tribe. You will be respected and revered if you serve our people well.
rows.quest:3108:obj:0: Read the Etched Rune and speak to Thorgas Grimson in Coldridge Valley.
rows.quest:3108:details:0: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the hunter trainer Thorgas. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3108:completion:0: One thing you should always remember is that you gotta respect the world you're livin' in. The beasts that choose to fight along side you; the shine of your weapon; the weight of your ammo; the bite of a bitter wind; all these things you need to know intimately.
rows.quest:3108:completion:1: BI'll do what I can to help you, but most of the work's up to you. Anytime you think you're ready, come back and talk to me. I'll train you when I can.
rows.quest:3117:obj:0: Read the Etched Sigil and speak to Ayanna Everstride at the top of Aldrassil in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:3117:details:0: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our hunter trainer, Ayanna. It seems Ayanna would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
rows.quest:3117:completion:0: As you experience what ⟦E1⟧ has to teach you, come see me--I will be able to help you understand more about your role as a ⟦7⟧ and what you are capable of.
rows.quest:3117:completion:1: BThese are dangerous times, ⟦8⟧, do not take for granted the skill of your pets--there are things in this world more dangerous than you can imagine. Go with ⟦E2⟧ and return to me again.
rows.quest:6061:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:6061:details:0: As a tauren, it is important to follow the traditions of our ancestors by fighting mighty creatures. By besting these creatures, we are able to intake their spirits, allowing us to become closer to the Earthmother.
rows.quest:6061:details:1: BIn the same way, taming a beast to fight alongside us helps us become one with nature around us. Eventually, you will learn to tame a beast of your choosing. But all things take practice, and you have much to learn. Begin by taking this taming rod; you must tame an adult plainstrider.
rows.quest:6061:completion:0: Signs have appeared to me from the Earthmother; you have done well.
rows.quest:6062:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:6062:details:0: It is an admirable skill to command one's authority over nature. As a hunter, you must strive to learn to use the force and power inherent to any creature of your choosing.
rows.quest:6062:details:1: BGaining control of an animal is not an easy feat; it is a task that you must undertake with much determination.
rows.quest:6062:details:2: BFor your first assignment, take this taming rod and use it to tame a dire mottled boar. You can find them quite close to Razor Hill. Practice your skills in battle with the boar at your side, then return to me.
rows.quest:6062:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦9⟧. I believe you are ready for your next task.
rows.quest:6063:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Webwood Lurker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:6063:details:0: As a hunter, it is important to remember the responsibility you hold in your hands. Nature is not a power that can be bent to obey our desires; it is one that is to be respected and acknowledged as something stronger than your very existence.
rows.quest:6063:details:1: B⟦10⟧, you must prove your understanding of this before you will gain the ability to tame an animal to be your companion.
rows.quest:6063:details:2: BYour first task is to take this taming rod. With it, you will be able to tame a webwood lurker. Tame it, and practice your skills as a hunter.
rows.quest:6063:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦11⟧! You are quite a fast learner.
rows.quest:6064:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Large Crag Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
rows.quest:6064:details:0: Hi there, ⟦12⟧! So, you'd be wanting to know how you can gain a pet of your own?
rows.quest:6064:details:1: BWell, let's get started. There's nothing more important than yer equipment when it comes to hunting, but we can chat about my new Shrapnel Blaster some other time. Fer now, let's focus on something I'm sure you're quite interested in: a pet!
rows.quest:6064:details:2: BThe best way to learn is for you to try out several creatures as companions and see what ya like. So, find a large crag boar, then use the taming rod to tame it.
rows.quest:6064:completion:0: I know, I know; you're wondering what's next, aren't ya?!
rows.quest:6065:obj:0: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:6065:details:0: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
rows.quest:6065:details:1: BYou must see Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
rows.quest:6065:completion:0: Yes, I do believe you are ready...

rows.quest:6081:details:0: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
rows.quest:6081:details:1: BTravel to ⟦E3⟧. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Ormak Grimshot. He will give you the ability to train your new pet. You will find him in the Valley of Honor.
rows.quest:6081:completion:0: A young ⟦17⟧, I see. Yes, I will grant you the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
rows.quest:6081:completion:1: BNow, go, ⟦18⟧. We will speak again, at a later date.
rows.quest:6082:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Armored Scorpid. Practice your skills, then return to Thotar at Razor Hill.
rows.quest:6082:details:0: The final creature you need to tame is one you should strive to emulate; the armored scorpid. It strikes quickly and confidently; to control a force such as this is your fate as a hunter.
rows.quest:6082:details:1: BWhen you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will be yours to command. Under your control, your pet will gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.⟦19⟧
rows.quest:6082:completion:0: You have learned all I can teach you, ⟦20⟧. It is time for you to take what you have learned here and choose a pet of your own.
rows.quest:6082:completion:1: BHere you are, ⟦21⟧. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.
rows.quest:6083:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar at Razor Hill.
rows.quest:6083:details:0: The advantage a pet affords you against your rivals is duly noted, ⟦22⟧. When you gain control over another creature, you are adding to your own strength. Your pet must become an extension of yourself.
rows.quest:6083:details:1: BThe next task requires you to turn from the land; you will find the next creature in the waters off the coast. Across from Sen'jin Village, near the Echo Isles. look for a spirited crab called the surf crawler. Use the taming rod to tame it, then practice your skills.
rows.quest:6083:completion:0: You are a swift learner, ⟦23⟧. You have done well.
rows.quest:6084:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
rows.quest:6084:details:0: Those crag boars are quite burly; maybe you'd like something with a little more finesse? Alright then, I've got jus' the thing. South and east of here, you'll find large white cats called snow leopards. Just like an elegantly-carved rifle, behind their beautiful exterior lies a powerful fighter, capable of doing extreme damage. You'll find them to be much more agile an' swift than the boar you tamed.
rows.quest:6084:details:1: BTake this taming rod and see how you like the snow leopard.
rows.quest:6084:completion:0: When I feel you've learned enough, I will grant you the ability to choose any pet of your liking.
rows.quest:6085:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice ⟦E4⟧ Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
rows.quest:6085:details:0: Perhaps you'd like a creature that possesses little more than brute strength. The ice claw bear is an excellent companion for a fledgling hunter like yourself, and can be found east of Kharanos. Here is the taming rod; try this animal as a pet and see if ya like it!
rows.quest:6085:details:1: BWhen you return, I'll give ya the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as ya like.⟦24⟧
rows.quest:6085:completion:0: Here you are, ⟦25⟧. I will now give ya the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you please.
rows.quest:6085:completion:1: BFind yerself a good, loyal pet, and enjoy the hunt!
rows.quest:6086:details:0: ⟦26⟧, ya now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills ta train it.
rows.quest:6086:details:1: BTravel to ⟦E5⟧ and find the Hall of ⟦E6⟧. There you must speak to one of our most revered animal trainers, Belia Thundergranite. She'll give ya the power to train your new pet, so get goin', ⟦27⟧!
rows.quest:6086:details:2: BBelia is a friendly sort; you should have no problems gaining her approval. Good luck, ⟦28⟧.⟦29⟧
rows.quest:6086:completion:0: A new recruit, eh? You're on your way to becoming a great ⟦30⟧, I see.
rows.quest:6086:completion:1: BYes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
rows.quest:6086:completion:2: BRemember that the key to getting the most from your new pet is to respect it and treat it well. In turn, your pet will be your most loyal friend.
rows.quest:6087:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:6087:details:0: You have a fiery spirit, hunter, readily awaiting your next challenge.
rows.quest:6087:details:1: BYour next task is to gain the companionship of a wolf known as the prairie stalker. This creature is swift and fearless; in taking this beast as your pet, you must also take on these qualities.
rows.quest:6087:details:2: BDuring a battle, you will learn how you and your pet will become a team. In the end you must work as one, muscle to muscle.
rows.quest:6087:details:3: BHere is the taming rod, ⟦31⟧. Tame a prairie stalker and practice your skills.
rows.quest:6087:completion:0: Yes... The Earthmother believes that you are ready for the next lesson.
rows.quest:6088:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:6088:details:0: The final task that I have for you requires that you tame a creature that inhabits the sky. The swoop is a difficult opponent, but as your ally, you will acquire its sharp attacks and threatening presence.
rows.quest:6088:details:1: BBy the will of the Earthmother, when you return I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.⟦32⟧
rows.quest:6088:completion:0: You have learned all I can teach you, ⟦33⟧. May the blessings of the Earthmother guide you in choosing a pet.
rows.quest:6088:completion:1: BHere you are, ⟦34⟧. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride and honor the Earthmother.
rows.quest:6089:obj:0: Speak with Holt Thunderhorn on Hunter Rise in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:6089:details:0: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
rows.quest:6089:details:1: BTravel to ⟦E7⟧. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Holt Thunderhorn. If he deems you worthy, he will give you the ability to train your new pet.
rows.quest:6089:details:2: BHolt has bested the most powerful and feared beasts of ⟦E8⟧, and commands many strong creatures of his own. His ties to the Earthmother are strong, and you can learn much from him. Good luck, ⟦35⟧.⟦36⟧
rows.quest:6089:completion:0: A young ⟦37⟧, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
rows.quest:6089:completion:1: BNow, go forth. May the Earthmother guide you on your path. We shall speak again, at a later date.
rows.quest:6101:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Nightsaber Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:6101:details:0: The variance of nature is something that can be relied upon, ⟦38⟧. It is predictable in the way that it never remains the same; it is always changing.
rows.quest:6101:details:1: BThe tasks I give to you will help you to see and appreciate the vast differences of the creatures you may choose as your companion.
rows.quest:6101:details:2: BTake this taming rod and use it to tame a nightsaber stalker, found to the south. Practice your skills as a hunter. Then you will begin to understand the similarities and differences of nature.
rows.quest:6101:completion:0: I see your commitment and that you have understood what I have taught you, ⟦39⟧.
rows.quest:6102:obj:0: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Strigid Screecher. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:6102:details:0: You have tamed two creatures that inhabit the land, now you must tame one that soars the skies. Use the taming rod to tame a strigid screecher, found west of here. Practice your skills with this mighty owl at your side.
rows.quest:6102:details:1: BWhen you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
rows.quest:6102:completion:0: You have learned all I can teach you, ⟦40⟧. May I offer you one more piece of advice: use discretion when choosing your first pet. Will you choose a creature of the land, of the water, or of the sky? Whatever it may be, without doubt, your pet will be with you for quite some time.
rows.quest:6102:completion:1: BHere you are, ⟦41⟧. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.
rows.quest:6103:obj:0: Speak to Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:6103:details:0: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
rows.quest:6103:details:1: BTravel to ⟦E9⟧. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Jocaste. She will give you the ability to train your new pet, so make haste.
rows.quest:6103:details:2: BWhile Jocaste may seem stern, she is always pleased to see another hunter rising through the ranks. Treat her with respect and she will return in kind. Good luck, ⟦42⟧.
rows.quest:6103:completion:0: A fledgling ⟦43⟧. I see. Yes. I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
rows.quest:6103:completion:1: BRemember, ⟦44⟧, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
rows.quest:6721:details:0: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
rows.quest:6721:details:1: BYou must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.⟦45⟧
rows.quest:6722:details:0: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
rows.quest:6722:details:1: BYou must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
rows.quest:7632:obj:0: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, ⟦48⟧; It's a big world.
rows.quest:7632:details:0: The epidermis of the leaf glows a bright green. The surface is extremely rugose, exposing several veins and wrinkles.
rows.quest:7632:details:1: BIf you had to take a guess, you would say this leaf came from something ancient and powerful.
rows.quest:7632:details:2: BMaybe you should find the original owner of this leaf?
rows.quest:7632:completion:0: Of course I recognize my own leaves. Look at that! It's in perfect condition.
rows.quest:7632:completion:1: BHow good of you to return it, ⟦49⟧.
rows.quest:7632:completion:2: BPerhaps you could be of service to us and we to you.
rows.quest:7633:completion:0: Your diligence and integrity has been noted, ⟦50⟧.
rows.quest:7633:completion:1: BWe are Ancients: Protectors of this once great forest. Our physical forms were destroyed 10,000 years ago when Archimonde and the ⟦E10⟧ marched upon ⟦E11⟧. Our spirits, however, remain intact.
rows.quest:7633:completion:2: BThere are tasks that we can offer. Tasks that if completed will open up the secrets of the Ancients to you.
rows.quest:7633:completion:3: BKnow this, should you complete these tasks, merely return to this rock and we shall answer the calling.
rows.quest:7634:obj:0: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:7634:details:0: Greetings, ⟦51⟧. I am Hastat, Ancient of Lore. I hold knowledge lost eons ago.
rows.quest:7634:details:1: BWith the proper binding, one of my leaves can serve as a quiver the likes of which has not been seen in 10,000 years. A quiver that when accompanied by a bow of Ancients, could grant untold powers.
rows.quest:7634:details:2: BReturn here with sinew from an adult blue dragon and this quiver shall be yours.
rows.quest:7634:completion:0: May my leaves provide your arrows protection from harm. May your arrows strike true. May the enemies of our world be smitten.
rows.quest:7635:obj:0: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:7635:details:0: Vartrus may offer you the stave to create a bow of Ancients but only I can enchant the string required to complete the bow.
rows.quest:7635:details:1: BIt is a simple task, puny one. Slay a mature black dragon and remove the sinew from its bones. Return that sinew to me and I shall enchant the material into an almost indestructible bow string.
rows.quest:7635:completion:0: A most foul dragon this one was. The sinew reeks of evil.
rows.quest:7635:completion:1: BGive me a moment to cleanse the filth from this flesh and apply the proper enchantments.
rows.quest:7636:obj:0: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:
rows.quest:7636:obj:5: BDestroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in ⟦E12⟧ with their heads.
rows.quest:7636:obj:6: BRefer to the Petrified ⟦E13⟧ in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.
rows.quest:7636:obj:7: BYou MUST complete this task by yourself.
rows.quest:7636:details:0: Agents of the ⟦E10⟧ are still active in our world, ⟦52⟧. These agents corrupt all that they touch. Nature wilts and weeps in their presence.
rows.quest:7636:details:1: BYou must track down these demonic corrupters and destroy them, ⟦53⟧. Be warned, you must engage them by yourself or they will flee. As long as you are alone, they will try and destroy you. You must strike at them, turning their arrogance into misery.
rows.quest:7636:details:2: BI grant you a piece of my bark, the inscriptions shall lead you to your targets. Retrieve their heads.
rows.quest:7636:completion:0: You have served us well, ⟦54⟧! Take this stave and combine it with the bow string that Stoma is able to create. Together, they form a most formidable weapon.
